segments.text: 姉妹の次女。
傍目はクールビューティーで生徒からの人気も高い。
基本的に無口で物静かだが弟ラブは長女にもまけず、体育の授業では率先して弟との二人組をつくり、スキンシップを図ってくる。
身体を動かすことが好きでスポーツも得意。弟にスポーツ指導をするため体育教師になった。
「母乳が栄養ある」という発言は深く考えずに言ったものだが、結果として弟とのスキンシップが増えることを内心で喜んでいる。

Lan's classmate. He comes from a noble family and is extremely elitist. He makes sarcastic remarks so often, one might wonder if sarcasm flows in his blood. He is especially harsh towards Nike and Lan.
若き公爵家当主。
先年、父である前公爵が早逝したため家督を継ぐ。
兄弟がなく、また母が正妻であったため揉める事なく相続できた。
“シアン”は“リシャール”にとって初の愛妾。

After her village was suddenly attacked, she lost both her father and her homeland. While fleeing, she accidentally became the wielder of a cursed sword and ends up joining Nirvana. Although she struggles to master the power of the cursed sword, she finds a new place for herself supported by her companions.

The elite warriors at Nirvana acknowledge Abel as the strongest student among them. Since his enrollment, he has gone undefeated, besting even instructors with his overwhelming strength and ability to remain calm in any situation. His communication skills are not nearly as polished, and he often comes across as brusque and cold...but it seems he has a kind side, too?

A prince from a small country. He has a carefree personality, and unbound by anything, he often sneaks out of the dormitory to indulge in the nightlife. He was sent to Nirvana in hopes of enhancing his military prowess for his country. He dislikes combat and prefers glamorous and enjoyable activities, yet his abilities are among the top in Nirvana.

He comes from the military nation of Daigroth. Following the orders of his family head, he came to Nirvana to hone his skills. In Daigroth, women customarily train as warriors, so he's only met women who are stronger than him. As a result, he gets nervous around women who do not fight and slightly distrusts them. He acts tough and claims to solely be interested in fighting, but of course, he's just as interested in women.

A shy, gentle, and compassionate boy. He dislikes fighting and has little talent for it, so he is perceived as an underachiever and is perpetually stationed at the medical unit in Nirvana. However, this doesn't seem to bother him. He goes into the forest to pick medicinal herbs almost daily.

He's so naturally handsome that women are drawn to him without any effort on his part. This often gets him into trouble. He genuinely dislikes the attention and complains about it, wishing that people would leave him alone. Additionally, Lustin regards him as a rival.

The person inside the cursed sword that Lan carries. He usually sleeps inside the cursed sword and wakes only on occasion. He is quite belligerent and extreme, leading him to make unconventional remarks. He mocks the protagonist as the weakest wielder of the sword in history.

Lan's classmate. He's very calm and often steps up as a class representative, bringing everyone together. It seems that his family originated from a far eastern country, and he uses a katana as his weapon.
A mysterious young man who shares a name with the cursed sword. Both his relationship with the sword and his background are shrouded in mystery.

Lan's classmate and roommate. She has a radiant personality and often encourages Lan. She hails from the military nation of Daigroth and excels in combat. Her skills are so proficient that she ranks within the school's top 10, even when fighting alongside boys in mock battles.

Nirvana's young supreme commander. Entrusted by Queen Qiora with the overall supervision of Nirvana. Dignified and compassionate, he cares about Lan's well-being. However, sometimes he is known to be too serious.

Possessing abundant knowledge of magic, he serves as a consultant in Nirvana. He is skilled in medical arts and usually works as a health physician in the infirmary. He always wears a faint smile, making his true feelings unreadable.

The king of Azul, a country of deserts and jewels, located in the northwest of Ortesia. He remains calm and composed at all times, rarely exposing his emotions. However, he sometimes tests those he sees potential in by gauging their reactions to his statements.
Nirvana's instructor. He treats all students with equal strictness. He looks after his young students and teaches them about the harsh realities of the battlefield every day.

The queen of the magical kingdom of Milveria and one of the founders of Nirvana. She is gentle, thoughtful, and a pacifist, yet her concealed magic power is said to be the greatest in the continent. The magical barrier protecting the entire royal capital is deployed by her magic alone. Her power is largely attributed to her special lineage, which significantly slows her aging. Contrary to her appearance, rumors say she is beyond 100 years old. She always has Lan in her thoughts and guides her kindly.

The king of the military nation Daigroth, located in the southeast of Ortesia. Leading a country brimming with powerful tribes and never-ending internal strife has made him quite bold. He takes a genuine interest in Lan and wishes for her growth.

A general of the military nation Daigroth and a beautiful woman known across Ortesia for her skill with a giant scythe. Belligerent, she mercilessly swings her blade against enemies, but shows deep affection to those she trusts. Although she speaks harshly to Lan, it is out of a desire to see Lan grow.

He runs a weapon shop in town and is friends with Tifalet. He speaks in a feminine manner. He's kind to female students from Nirvana, but is generally harsh and sarcastic towards male students. He has a lot of knowledge about various topics.

The owner of Green Drops, a tavern in town. The tavern offers services as a dining hall and is frequented by many students from Nirvana. Ghido is cheerful and friendly, and many of the male students trust him. He seems to be especially close with Lustin, who is a regular. He is a doting father to Collette.

Ghido's beloved daughter, known for her gentle and kind nature. She always works with a smile as the poster girl of Green Drops. She is close with Yuriana and warmly welcomes Lan, as Nirvana has very few female students.
